title: The Door With Your Emblem
text: A door stands alone in the open hillside, frame and all, with nothing behind it but grass and wind. On it, in paint gone pale with age, are the arms of one of your Houses. Nobody living remembers having it made.

options.label: Its House opens the door it never built.

outcomes.text: A room that was never built, full of things that were always theirs. And a letter, sealed, to be opened at home.
A hallway of their own house, the way it will look when they are all dead. They close it quickly.
When you look back the door is gone, and the paint is on your hands. It will not wash off, and the next thing you fight can smell it.
